summary: Frontend-only test of file upload indication on /inscricao.html for DOC_FRENTE and DOC_VERSO inputs. Both inputs correctly update their name label element with the file name and receive the 'has-file' CSS class after selection. Bug is fixed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The change listener on .doc-file-input works: after set_input_files on #DOC_FRENTE the #DOC_FRENTE_name element text becomes 'frente_test.png' with class 'doc-file-name has-file'. Same works for #DOC_VERSO -> 'verso_test.pdf'. No 'Nenhum arquivo selecionado' persistence issue.
rca of the issue: Original bug: file inputs had opacity:0 overlay and no change listener, so selecting a file did not update the visible label. Fix added querySelectorAll('.doc-file-input').forEach change handler that sets textContent to files[0].name and adds 'has-file' class. Verified working via Playwright set_input_files.
